finalText:
All 40 pass now.

Root cause: `computeTotal` rounded to 2 decimals after each coupon step (percent, then flat), while still in USD, then converted and rounded again — double rounding. Cents got clipped before currency multiply, so drift only surfaces on non-USD orders (rate ≠ 1) where pre-rounded cents don't survive the multiply cleanly. USD orders never failed since rate=1 makes the extra round a no-op. Explains "most look fine, hard to spot pattern" — only non-USD + percent-coupon stacks tripped it.

Fix: round only once, at the end, after currency conversion — matches contract already stated in code comment.
